links.outcome: External discrimination and calibration of VOID model for predicting permanent SNM implantation
links.effect: AUC 0.627 (fair discrimination), Brier score 0.221 (poor overall accuracy), imperfect calibration; only female sex remained independently associated (OR 2.08, 95% CI 1.14-3.79).
links.quote: The VOID model demonstrated only fair discrimination and suboptimal calibration, precluding immediate clinical use without prior recalibration.

screen.reason: Retrospective multicenter external validation of the VOID multivariable predictive risk score for sacral neuromodulation outcomes, evaluating discrimination and calibration across 7 centers.
